manifest.name: Diagnostic
manifest.description: Reports what the reader misses on an article, and builds a pack to fix it.

settings.autoSignalsHint: Hodi notes articles blocked, too short or with page leftovers

dialog.title: Report a problem
dialog.introStart: Say what is wrong. Hodi keeps
dialog.introKept: the original page and its extraction
dialog.failed: The report could not be sent.
dialog.gone: This article is no longer in Hodi.
dialog.captureFailed: The screenshot could not be sent.
dialog.removeMessage: It leaves the list and your next pack.
dialog.dailyLimit: That’s enough reports for today. Come back tomorrow.

list.title: Already reported
list.intro: What you reported on this article. Something else wrong? Report it too.

capture.hint: PNG, JPG · 5 MB each · {{count}} at most

errors.tooBig: {{name}} is too big (5 MB at most).
errors.notAnImage: {{name}} isn’t a PNG or JPG image.

page.title: Reports
page.intro: What profiles of every household reported, and what Hodi spotted alone. The pack is for fixing the reader.
page.emptyText: Profiles report an article from the reader, under its text.
page.clearHint: Once the pack is sent and fixed
page.clearMessage: Reports, kept pages and screenshots are deleted for good.

megabytes.title: Room for the pack
megabytes.intro: Past it, Hodi first erases the oldest screenshots, then the oldest reports.

days.title: Kept for
days.intro: An older report is erased, with its screenshots and its page.

perDay.title: Reports a day
perDay.intro: What one profile can report in 24 hours, so no single one fills the pack.
